{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the exact string values in 'revenue' again
print("Unique values in 'revenue':")
print(df['revenue'].unique())

# Check for '999,999.99' explicitly
print(f"\nAny rows with '999,999.99'? {('999,999.99' in df['revenue'].values)}")

# Count how many rows have '999,999.99'
count_999k = (df['revenue'] == '999,999.99').sum()
print(f"\nNumber of rows with revenue == '999,999.99': {count_999k}")

# Now, filter out those rows
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999,999.99']

# Check the shape
print(f"\nShape of df_clean: {df_clean.shape}")

# Check if any '999,999.99' remain
remaining = df_clean[df_clean['revenue'] == '999,999.99']
print(f"\nNumber of remaining '999,999.99' rows: {len(remaining)}")

# Print the first few rows of df_clean
print("\nFirst few rows of df_clean:")
print(df_clean.head())"}
